result.instructions: Tools for Chronicle Online, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who clocked in late this week, and by how many minutes?"; "List the absences booked for Sam Carter in October."; "Which shifts are scheduled for the Dock team next Monday?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Chronicle Online data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run chronicleonline_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run chronicleonline_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run chronicleonline_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. chronicleonline_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.description: List employees (and contractors, visitors, agency staff) with their badge ids, names and cost centre. Good first call to find an employee id. Chronicle API: GET /api/Employees.
